title: Light Cured American White Fish Skewers
description: A quick and easy American dish featuring white fish, cured to perfection and served on a salt block, with a sour and snappy flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the salt block to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the white fish into 1-inch pieces and place in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Pour the marinade over the fish and mix to coat.
Thread the marinated fish onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
Repeat the process for the remaining fish and skewers.
